status_as_of_cutoff: Maryland issued a final air-quality permit for Amazon's generator plant on March 25, 2026. The air permit is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, utility interconnection, or proof of energized IT load. Physical stage was not fully established from official records.

actions.result_status: MDE final-determination materials state that Amazon Data Services' air-permit application for 3250 Digital Drive was received on October 29, 2024.
actions.access_caveat: Application receipt is not approval; the final permit PDF is a separate MDE document.
actions.evidence_note: Air application for emergency generators, not building approval.

actions.result_status: MDE approved and issued the final air-quality permit for Amazon Data Services at 3250 Digital Drive, covering the generator installation described in the final determination. MDE identifies four data-center buildings in the project record.
actions.access_caveat: The official issued-permit PDF is linked from MDE's data-center page; the accessible final-determination/news pages do not expose a clear permit number in the text.
actions.evidence_note: Air permit for stationary generators; not a building permit, CO, or energization record.

actions.result_status: County announced a pause on new data-center applications while exempting approved and under-construction work. This is policy context and does not approve or revoke Amazon's air permit.
actions.access_caveat: County news release summarizes the policy; it is not a project-specific permit record.
actions.evidence_note: Policy action, not construction or occupancy approval.
